topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Defocused systems face increased interference due to larger element spacing, directly impacting capacity and efficiency.  To minimize dB loss, a trade-off exists between element spacing for both signal interference reduction (beamforming flexibility) and bandwidth efficiency. This necessitates careful consideration of system architecture and antenna configurations. Advanced techniques like adaptive beamforming can mitigate interference, potentially leading to improved system performance.
